Plugin.Name: WeComHub
Plugin.Overview: Unraid WeCom (WeChat Work) hub plugin. Forwards Unraid system notifications to WeCom through a self-hosted relay with importance filtering, and accepts WeCom commands to run whitelisted read-only queries (status/docker/uptime/disk) or restart prefix-allowed containers. Configured entirely from Settings - Notification: no env files, no /boot/config/go edits.
